children: Transaction values AMPERA at approximately $900 million on a pre-money equity basis.

Transaction expected to provide up to approximately $357 million in gross cash proceeds, including more than $30 million from a common stock private investment in public equity ("PIPE") financing, $10 million in pre-transaction close equity and debt financing commitments, and $317 million of cash held in Berto's trust account, assuming no redemptions by Berto's public shareholders and before payment of transaction expenses.

The PIPE financing and recent investments have been anchored by several key strategic investors across diversified end markets in which AMPERA intends to sell into, including AI data centers, quantum computing, defense, maritime and industrial sectors.

PALM BEACH GARDENS, Fla. and LAS VEGAS, Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- AMPERA, Inc. (AMPERA), a next-generation energy company developing compact, modular and scalable systems, and Berto Acquisition Corp. ("Berto"), a publicly traded special purpose acquisition company (Nasdaq: TACO), today announced that they have entered into a definitive agreement for a business combination. The transaction implies an equity value for AMPERA of approximately $900 million on a pre-money equity.

Targeting energy demand needs, AMPERA is developing scalable power solutions for data center, defense, industrial and maritime applications. As part of its business strategy, AMPERA is pursuing near-term commercial power generation using heat recovery and conventional fuels through its PowerNOW™ program, while simultaneously conducting longer-term development of advanced nuclear technology through its NuclearNEXT™ approach. AMPERA is combining advanced manufacturing, artificial intelligence, emerging quantum computing capabilities and next-generation energy technologies to develop reliable, highly efficient, factory-built power systems.

In connection with the business combination, on Nov. 17, 2026, Berto entered into subscription agreements ("PIPE Subscription Agreements") with certain institutional and accredited investors and strategic investors (the "Subscribers"). Pursuant to the PIPE Subscription Agreements, Berto has agreed to issue and sell, and the Subscribers agreed to subscribe for and purchase at closing, in a private placement, an aggregate of approximately $30 million of shares of Class A common stock of the post-merger combined company, at a per share price equal to the price at which Berto's public shares may be redeemed in connection with the business combination. In addition to the PIPE financing, AMPERA has closed or received commitments for an additional $10 million in pre-transaction close equity and debt financing, bringing total capital commitments in excess of $40 million to date. The PIPE and the company's existing investors include a leading AI data center equipment provider, one of the world's largest quantum computing companies, a global maritime company, a U.S. defense contractor and a Middle East industrial investor.

Berto and AMPERA are in discussions with a number of strategic and institutional investors regarding an additional $50 million to $100 million of PIPE capital. No definitive agreements have been signed for this additional capital, there is no assurance it will be raised, and the final amount may be higher or lower. Any additional capital would be incremental to the PIPE described above, and the transaction is not conditioned on its being raised. The minimum cash condition in the transaction is set at the final PIPE raise amount. Accordingly, the transaction has no minimum cash condition above the amount of PIPE capital raised. For illustrative purposes, assuming $100 million of additional PIPE capital and no redemptions, gross capital available to AMPERA could exceed $450 million.

Upon closing, which is subject to approval by the stockholders of both AMPERA and Berto, receipt of required regulatory approvals and satisfaction or waiver of customary closing conditions, including the minimum cash condition described above, the combined company is expected to be named "AMPERA, Inc." and is anticipated to list on the Nasdaq Stock Market under the ticker symbol "AMPR", subject to Nasdaq approval. The transaction is currently expected to close in the first quarter of 2027, although there can be no assurance regarding the timing or completion of the transaction. AMPERA intends to use expected proceeds from the transaction to fund its platform development and initial commercial scale-up, although the amount of proceeds available to the combined company will depend on, among other things, the level of redemptions by Berto's shareholders and the total amount of financing raised.

"This transaction represents a defining milestone for AMPERA as we work to bring our advanced energy technologies to market," said Brian Matthews, Founder and CEO, AMPERA. "The rapid growth of AI infrastructure, data centers and industrial electrification is creating unprecedented demand for reliable, scalable power. Our PowerNOW platform is designed to address that demand through modular, high-efficiency power generation systems, with initial commercial deliveries targeted for 2027. In parallel, our NuclearNEXT program is advancing a fundamentally different approach to nuclear energy through a source-assisted, subcritical thorium architecture. We believe the combination of near-term commercial opportunities and longer-term nuclear innovation creates a compelling foundation for significant growth."

AMPERA is developing a proprietary supercritical carbon dioxide (sCO₂) platform, the sPower™ power conversion cycle. The sPower technology is applicable across PowerNOW solutions, gas turbine bottoming cycles, industrial heat recovery and eventually NuclearNEXT.
AMPERA's PowerNOW strategy provides fuel flexibility, efficiency and deployability advantages. The company currently plans to offer four configurations:
AMP-G7.5: AMPERA's initial natural-gas-fired system utilizing sPower, targeting 7.5MW net electrical output and commercial production in Q4 2027.
AMP-G15: The next-generation evolution of AMP-G7.5, utilizing an enhanced sPower conversion system, targeting 15MW net electrical output.
sPower Heat Recovery: For use in industrial waste heat recovery, efficient bottoming cycle on gas turbines and other third-party heat sources.

PowerNOW Gas Turbine Variant: A higher-capacity configuration under development that integrates a conventional gas turbine with AMPERA's proprietary sPower bottoming cycle, targeting up to 45MW total electrical output.

Under its NuclearNEXT strategy, AMPERA is developing the AMP-N15 to include a proprietary thorium-fueled, factory-sealed reactor based on a source-assisted subcritical architecture that targets 15MW net electrical output and an up-to 30-year core life with no routine refueling.

"We believe the combined entity will create significant value for shareholders by capturing what we see as a transformational market opportunity," said Harry L. You, Executive Chairman, Berto Acquisition Corp. "AMPERA is uniquely positioned to lead the commercialization of near-term power production and the industrialization of nuclear energy at scale, serving the power demand from AI data centers, defense applications, maritime and industrial users. The AMPERA nuclear platform distinctively combines subcritical architecture, thorium fuel, no refueling, environmentally friendly non-water based cooling, and factory manufacturing in a single system. We have great confidence in the leadership of Brian Matthews and his team."
Advisors
Needham & Company, LLC is serving as financial advisor to AMPERA and as placement agent for the PIPE transaction. Sichenzia Ross Ference Carmel LLP is serving as legal advisor to AMPERA.
White & Case LLP is serving as legal advisor to Berto.
Important Information About The Proposed Business Combination And Where To Find It

In connection with the proposed business combination, AMPERA and Berto (together the "Parties") intend to file relevant materials with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC"), including a registration statement on Form S-4 (the "Registration Statement"), which will include a preliminary proxy statement of Berto and a preliminary prospectus with respect to the securities to be offered in the business combination. After the Registration Statement is declared effective, Berto will mail the definitive proxy statement included therein to holders of Berto's ordinary shares in connection with Berto's solicitation of proxies for the vote of Berto's shareholders with respect to the proposed business combination. This press release is not a substitute for the Registration Statement or any other document that may be filed by the Parties with the SEC.
